# E0420: not a viewable type

Only a `str` or a `List` can be viewed. Take the value itself.

- Rule: [`views.viewable-types`](../../reference/13-modes.md#views.viewable-types)
- Reported at: the type argument of `View` or `Iter.of`'s argument, where it is written or inferred.
- Tier: `advanced`, checked in the `analyses` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0420:3
use std.view

fn count(v: view.View<i64>) -> i64 { v.len() }
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
use std.view

fn count(v: view.View<List<i64>>) -> i64 { v.len() }
```

## What the compiler prints

`stilt check` on [`E0420_not_a_viewable_type.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0420_not_a_viewable_type.lt):

```text
── NOT A VIEWABLE TYPE ────────────── E0420_not_a_viewable_type.lt:3:23  [E0420]

`i64` can't be viewed: only a `str` or a `List` can:

  3 │ fn count(v: view.View<i64>) -> i64 { v.len() }
    │                       ^^^

Only a `str` or a `List` can be viewed. Take the value itself.
```
